description: Distinct Portal Users Per Month is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Distinct Portal Users Per Month dataset provides information on the number of users accessing our Open Data Portal in a rolling 3 month window, meaning the first and current months will tend to be incomplete. These figures are highlighted via KPI cards on the home page. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. Its keywords are Open Data Function. The portal shows 2025-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
